population: All 772 occupations, equally weighted, all 35 binary important-skill indicators; no exposure or outlook inputs
sourceMetric: Exact binary Jaccard distance, two empty sets distance 0. Exclude self before selecting neighbors.
recall: For kth source distance t, L={d<t-tolerance}, T={abs(d-t)<=tolerance}, q=k-|L|. E is Euclidean displayed top-k, ties canonical code. R=(|E intersect L|+min(q,|E intersect T|))/k. Mean all rows at k=5,10,20; S is mean of these three recalls.
display: UMAP isotropic scaling with bounding-box midpoint at (0.5,0.5), longest axis range 0.8; round to 8 decimals BEFORE evaluating. No forced separation. Baseline is existing PCA display including offsets, at its actual precision; raw PCA is supplemental.
qualification: All three seeds successful; mean S >= PCA S + 0.02; mean recall >= PCA at each k; every seed S > PCA S.
selection: Highest mean S among qualifying configurations; exact ties higher minimum seed S then prescribed n_neighbors/min_dist order. Ship seed 11. If none qualify, default PCA and ship highest-ranked fully successful UMAP configuration for optional comparison. No extra tuning.
stability: Map displayed top-k neighbors to exact binary-profile identity. Pair overlap = sum_g min(countA(g),countB(g))/k, averaged equally across rows. Report every within-configuration seed pair and adjacent grid settings at seed 11, plus summaries.
diagnostics: Report total/unique profiles, singleton-profile versus repeated-profile population recalls, empty/missing counts, source canonical top-k symmetrized graph components. These do not change selection.
reproduction: One selected seed-11 confirmation rerun, outside selection; save and compare rounded coordinates exactly.
limits: In-sample descriptive metric, not external occupational ground truth. Duplicate profiles may separate algorithmically. Global axes and distances are not interpretable. Do not select using appearance. No extra grid phase.
